body:
> # **Heads Up!** - Update and Revision Coming **Soon™**!
> > I've been busy With IRL Stuff so haven't had a chance to maintain and update this too much lately but I plan to update and revise this pack and my [Other Pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/skybound-spelunking-ore-crafting) as well! I also plan to revist some older pack ideas I had thought about as well as continue to work on some adaptaions/ports of packs I had to put on hold due to personal life... Anyways, start looking forward to more from me in the _nearish_ future and I hope to see all those still interested stick around! 
> > 
> > Until then I hope y'all have an amazing time and keep letting your imaginations climbing past the build limit! ~ NicKnack819



## Pack Description:

Simple data pack for a world height adjustment! 
The acronym stands for:
"Depths And Altitudes Absurdly Amplified More Insanely Then Normal Installations Could!"

### New Build Limit Ranges:
 - Overworld: -64 to 2096
 - Nether: -64 to 1024
 - End: 0 to 1024
